name: redshift-data
description: You can use the Amazon Redshift Data API to run queries on Amazon Redshift tables. You can run SQL statements, which are committed if the statement succeeds.

subcommands.name: batch-execute-statement
subcommands.description: Runs one or more SQL statements, which can be data manipulation language (DML) or data definition language (DDL).

options.name: --client-token
options.description: A unique, case-sensitive identifier that you provide to ensure the idempotency of the request

options.name: --cluster-identifier
options.description: The cluster identifier. This parameter is required when connecting to a cluster and authenticating using either Secrets Manager or temporary credentials

options.name: --database
options.description: The name of the database. This parameter is required when authenticating using either Secrets Manager or temporary credentials

options.name: --db-user
options.description: The database user name. This parameter is required when connecting to a cluster as a database user and authenticating using temporary credentials

options.name: --result-format
options.description: The data format of the result of the SQL statement. If no format is specified, the default is JSON

options.name: --secret-arn
options.description: The name or ARN of the secret that enables access to the database. This parameter is required when authenticating using Secrets Manager

options.name: --session-id
options.description: The session identifier of the query

options.name: --session-keep-alive-seconds
options.description: The number of seconds to keep the session alive after the query finishes. The maximum time a session can keep alive is 24 hours.

options.name: --sqls
options.description: One or more SQL statements to run.  The SQL statements are run as a single transaction. They run serially in the order of the array.

options.name: --statement-name
options.description: The name of the SQL statements. You can name the SQL statements when you create them to identify the query

options.name: --with-event
options.description: A value that indicates whether to send an event to the Amazon EventBridge event bus after the SQL statements run

options.name: --no-with-event
options.description: A value that indicates whether to send an event to the Amazon EventBridge event bus after the SQL statements run

options.name: --workgroup-name
options.description: The serverless workgroup name or Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided. The JSON string follows the format provided by ``--generate-cli-skeleton``.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.
